name: Nakajima Ki-43-II Oscar
blurb: The game's original Blender Oscar: a measured real-aircraft silhouette with moving main gear, a 3-blade propeller and working control surfaces.
history:
The Nakajima Ki-43 Hayabusa was the Imperial Japanese Army Air Service's most numerous fighter. Light, maneuverable and pleasant to fly, it served from China and Burma through New Guinea and the Philippines. Allied pilots called it Oscar and sometimes confused it with the Navy's Zero.

What this entry models: an original Ki-43-IIb, 35 ft 7 in across and 29 ft 3 in long, measured from the Wikimedia Commons three-view linked from the English Wikipedia article and corrected to the IIb's cited dimensions, 3-blade propeller and taller canopy. It is the model used in flight; the retired download remains in the DEV Hangar.
